source.selectionPolicy: Overture named leisure/food business, confidence >=0.8, provider record ID and license; same full normalized house number including slash; exact Latin/Cyrillic-transliterated street tokens after removing road-type words; OSM address point <=150 m; exclude OSM POI/landmark name similarity >=0.70 within 150 m and hand-reviewed translated-name duplicates.
